metadata.description: Daniel (Elian-Studio)'s Claude Code plugin marketplace. Ships a single bundled plugin (elian-store) packaging multiple workflow skills. Every change must pass PR review + a 90-point Quality Gate (heuristic, no external API dependency).

plugins.name: elian-store
plugins.description: Daniel (Elian-Studio)'s workflow skill bundle. Includes decision-dashboard, /generate-teammate with 14 domain-expert agents, the TDD family (/implement, /fix, /improve), /brainstorm, the skill-meta pair (/manage-skills, /verify-implementation), and /on-call-elian (fixed-persona review with a locked OUTPUT FORMAT + optional --depth interview convergence loop).
